# collin rijock

> software engineer in miami. lead software engineer at exowatt. i love building software, and i'm getting into building hardware.

the front page is a hero, then one big shared canvas (the sections below as articles, plus the things i've made, ideas and writing, with simulated agent cursors sorting and wiring it up), then a 3d fly-through of the same content that ends in "say hi."

## how i build

- i love building software.
- i build a lot of it, with a lot of agents.
- and i'm getting into building hardware.
- climb the mountain.

## now

- exowatt (https://exowatt.com): lead software engineer, and the second software hire. exowatt makes 24-hour solar for ai data centers: sunlight in, heat stored, electricity on demand. i build the software the company and its energy sites run on.

## on the side

- super charles (https://app.collinrijock.com): my life on one postgres db. tasks, calendar, health and money, with agents that do the work. runs on a mac mini at home.

## before

- buildrfi (2024 to 2025): founding engineer at a miami proptech startup doing lending and payments for construction subcontractors. techstars and metaprop accelerator company. took a contractor lending product from zero to live loans; wired plaid, stripe and quickbooks into an ai underwriting engine; shipped a claude-powered document parser. stood on the floor of the new york stock exchange with the metaprop cohort in march 2025.
- lula (2022 to 2024): early engineer at a miami insurtech ("stripe for insurance"). built much of the first platform, owned onboarding and add-vehicle, led automated underwriting. there through the series b.
- kabcash (2021): founding engineer at a mexico city fintech. built the react native app in college, owned payments, shipped to the app store. started at miami hack week.
- fiu applied research center (2021): ml engineer. lstm anomaly detection on navy sensor data.

## things i've made

at exowatt (most of it stays inside; in broad strokes):

- the internal company platform: the software the whole company runs on.
- an energy management system, taken from simulation to commanding real hardware.
- ai research, with patents: agents that operate energy sites.
- a digital twin in a game engine: real-time 3d twins of energy sites and hardware.
- my own coding harness and ade: forked an open-source agent app into an agentic development environment, shipped to every engineer.
- a webkit browser: my own fork, built for agents to drive.

on my own time:

- super charles: my life on one postgres db, with agents that do the work. https://app.collinrijock.com
- skill-files: agent skills you install with one npx command. https://github.com/collinrijock/skill-files
- voice-os: a push-to-talk voice os. https://github.com/collinrijock/voice-os
- stream deck daemon: drives a stream deck over raw hid, no vendor app.
- legends of the friendgroup: a pixel-art tavern auto-battler, built with agents driving unity. https://github.com/collinrijock/LegendsOfTheFriendgroup
- pokemon showdown bot: a deep reinforcement learning bot. https://github.com/collinrijock/Pokemon-Showdown-Bot
- carecart: matched volunteers with people who needed groceries (shellhacks 2020). https://devpost.com/software/carecart-r6gckp

under nda:

- some of my work isn't public yet, from exowatt and my own projects. people can sign a short nda and request access at https://collinrijock.com/nda. i approve each request by hand, and approved people get a private link by email. there is nothing to read here or on that page without that access.
